title: Deep Batch Active Learning by Diverse, Uncertain Gradient Lower Bounds

anchors.quote: Algorithm 1 BADGE: Batch Active learning by Diverse Gradient Embeddings
anchors.paraphrase_zh: BADGE 在当前分类器下用预测标签构造最后一层梯度嵌入，再以 k-means++ 式分散选择同时表达不确定性与批内覆盖。

anchors.quote: Figure 3: Active learning test accuracy versus the number of total labeled samples for a range of conditions.
anchors.paraphrase_zh: 实验跨 11 个 dataset-architecture 组合、三种 batch size 和七种 acquisition 方法，每轮从头训练并重复五次。

anchors.paraphrase_zh: 学习曲线直接显示 diversity 与 uncertainty 的相对价值随训练阶段反转，且表示质量会决定覆盖方法能否胜过随机。

LIMITATIONS.pages: 7, 10 and 24, discussion and reported failure boundaries

anchors.paraphrase_zh: 作者承认 BADGE 有效的根本原因仍未解决；梯度下界只保证幅度信息，复杂表示、随机 seeding 和大批量计算均构成边界。

formulas: For softmax probability p_i, penultimate representation z(x;V), and hallucinated label y-hat=argmax_i p_i, class block i of the final-layer gradient embedding is (p_i-I[y-hat=i]) z(x;V).
Proposition 1 shows that the hallucinated-label gradient norm is the minimum over all possible labels and therefore lower-bounds the final-layer gradient magnitude after the true label is observed.
k-means++-style sampling chooses subsequent centers with probability proportional to squared distance from the nearest selected gradient embedding.
The lower bound concerns magnitude and representation geometry; it does not establish the signed effect of training on an independent target loss or FN95 frontier.
algorithm_steps: Draw an initial M labeled examples uniformly from the unlabeled pool and train the current classifier.
For every remaining example, hallucinate the current predicted class and compute its final-layer loss-gradient embedding.
Select B disparate high-magnitude embeddings using k-means++-style seeding, query their labels, and remove them from the unlabeled pool.
Retrain the classifier from scratch on the enlarged labeled set until training accuracy exceeds 99%.
Repeat acquisition and retraining for the requested number of active-learning rounds.
variables: unlabeled pool U, labeled set S, initial count M, acquisition batch B, and rounds T
network parameters theta, output-layer parameters theta_out, and penultimate representation z(x;V)
predicted probability p_i, hallucinated label y-hat, true label y, and gradient embeddings g_x and g_x^y
nearest selected-center distance and k-means++ sampling probability
label budget, test error, normalized error, pairwise penalty, training time, and acquisition time
selection_timing: Selection is checkpoint conditioned: one batch is chosen after each full retraining round using the current model's predicted labels and representation.
refresh_rule: All pool embeddings and selected centers are recomputed after the newly labeled batch is added and the classifier is retrained from scratch.

budget.unit: new unique labels acquired per active-learning round
budget.denominator: the remaining unlabeled pool and the total dataset label budget
budget.unique_sample_definition: An acquired identity leaves the pool and is not selected again, so acquisition IDs are unique; all acquired examples remain in every later retraining set.
budget.repeat_definition: Previously acquired examples are repeatedly optimizer-visible during every later retraining, but per-ID epoch exposure is not reported.
budget.cumulative_exposure_definition: Label counts are matched across selectors, while optimizer exposure is path dependent because each round retrains until exceeding 99% training accuracy.
budget.compute_cost: Every round requires full-pool gradient embeddings plus from-scratch training; k-DPP sampling can run out of memory at batch size 10,000 and is much slower than k-means++ at batch size 1,000.

random_baselines: uniform random acquisition at the same label budgets
confidence, margin, and entropy uncertainty sampling
Active Learning by Learning hybrid selection
datasets: OpenML #184 and other reported OpenML dataset-architecture pairs

seed_count.scope: all dataset, architecture, acquisition-method, batch-size, and label-budget conditions
seed_count.aggregation: learning-curve standard errors and paired five-repeat error differences; seed identities and worst-repeat tables are not provided.

checkpoint_selection: Models are retrained from scratch after every acquisition and stopped when training accuracy exceeds 99%; no independent validation checkpoint rule is reported, so optimizer-visible work varies with stochastic path.

results.claim: 聚合 33 个 dataset/batch/architecture 组合后，BADGE 的 pairwise penalty 列均值最低。
results.value: Column-wise average penalty is 0.66 for BADGE, compared with 6.90 for Coreset and 6.01 for Random; lower is better.

anchor.paraphrase_zh: 聚合矩阵支持 BADGE 在论文条件中的总体竞争力，但它把许多预算与任务压成平均 penalty，不能说明 Stage1 最差 seed。

ablations: diversity-only, uncertainty-only, hybrid, and uniform-random acquisition
MLP, convolutional, VGG, and ResNet representation quality
negative_results: Coreset diversity can be worse than uniform random when penultimate representations are poor.
The relative value of diversity and uncertainty reverses between early and later acquisition rounds.
At large label budgets all methods converge, reducing the informative comparison region.
k-DPP sampling runs out of memory at batch size 10,000 and is much slower at 1,000.
The discussion explicitly leaves the fundamental explanation for BADGE's empirical success open.
failure_conditions: The current representation clusters nuisance, source, or video identity rather than target-relevant variation.
Hallucinated-label gradient magnitude is mistaken for the signed true-label update on an independent target loss.
One checkpoint's geometry is treated as stable across training phases.
The first-center rule, RNG, ties, checkpoint hash, or gradient dimensionality is not persisted.
Compute or memory grows beyond the feasible full-pool embedding and pairwise-distance budget.
limitations: BADGE studies label acquisition, not additional replay over a fixed labeled base-training stream.
The hallucinated gradient is a magnitude lower bound and contains no independent FN95 target direction.
Label budget is matched but cumulative optimizer exposure and stopping work are not.
Five repetitions do not provide held training-seed confirmation or worst-seed evidence.
The aggregate penalty matrix spans many comparisons without visible multiplicity correction.
The public paper algorithm and executable first-center convention differ, showing a reproducibility-sensitive stochastic detail.
stage1_mechanism_zh: 该文支持把 D 写成当前 checkpoint 下、候选门控之后的集合覆盖：保存真实标签与 hallucinated 梯度嵌入、最近中心距离、有效秩、来源/视频集中度以及完整 seeding 顺序。它也直接反驳“diversity 永远有益”，因为表示差和阶段变化会使 Coreset 输给随机。
stage1_non_inference_zh: BADGE 不能证明高梯度幅度样本具有 replay utility；其梯度只给不确定性幅度下界，不含独立 FN95 的符号方向。论文改变已标注集合并每轮从头训练，没有固定基础流、累计 replay 曝光、optimizer steps、R1/R2/current-loss/no-replay 或未见 seed 配对。
exclusion_reason: NOT_APPLICABLE_WITH_REASON:eligible as checkpoint-conditioned gradient-coverage and redundancy evidence
